title: Cast a Spell
subtitle: Use a spell with a 1-bonus-action cast time
description: You can cast a spell with a casting time of 1 bonus action by using your bonus action for the turn.

bullets.content: You can't cast another spell during the same turn, except for a cantrip with a casting time of 1 action.

title: Offhand Attack
subtitle: Part of Two-Weapon Fighting
description: When you take the Attack action with a light melee weapon, you can use a bonus action to attack with a different light melee weapon you're holding in your other hand.

bullets.content: The following rules apply to this bonus action attack:

items: You don't add your ability modifier to the damage of the bonus attack, unless that modifier is negative.
If either weapon has the thrown property, you can throw the weapon, instead of making a melee attack with it.

bullets.content: This is a common feature of dual-wielding fighting styles.

title: Use Class Feature
subtitle: Activate a feature requiring a bonus action
description: Various class features, spells, and other abilities let you take an additional action on your turn called a bonus action.
reference: See class page for more information.

bullets.content: You can take a bonus action only when a special ability, spell, or other feature of the game states that you can do something as a bonus action.

title: Overrun*
subtitle: Force movement through a hostile space
description: When a creature tries to move through a hostile creature's space, the mover can try to force its way through by overrunning the hostile creature.

items: As a bonus action, the mover makes a Strength (Athletics) check contested by the hostile creature's Strength (Athletics) check.
The mover has advantage if it is larger than the hostile creature, or disadvantage if it is smaller.
If the mover wins the contest, it can move through the hostile creature's space once this turn.

bullets.content: This is an optional rule from the Dungeon Master's Guide.

title: Tumble*
subtitle: Weave through a hostile space
description: A creature can try to tumble through a hostile creature's space, ducking and weaving past the opponent.

items: As a bonus action, the tumbler makes a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check contested by the hostile creature's Dexterity (Acrobatics) check.
If the tumbler wins the contest, it can move through the hostile creature's space once this turn.

bullets.content: This is an optional rule from the Dungeon Master's Guide.

title: Drink a Potion **
subtitle: A common house rule
description: This is a common homebrew rule that allows drinking a potion as a bonus action.

bullets.content: Standard rules require using an Action to drink a potion. This popular house rule offers an alternative:

items: When using a Bonus Action to drink a potion, you roll for the amount of health restored, as per the potion's description.
If you use a full Action, you regain the maximum possible amount of health instead of rolling.

bullets.content: Always confirm with your Dungeon Master if this house rule is in use.
